name: Renegade Ogryn Brutes
loadout: Every model is equipped with: Ogryn weapon.

faction.name: Dark Pacts
faction.description_html:
If your Army Faction is HERETIC ASTARTES, each time a unit with this ability is selected to shoot or fight, it can make a Dark Pact. If it does, it must first take a Leadership test before any effects of that Dark Pact are resolved; if that test is failed, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then, select one of the following abilities for that unit’s weapons to gain until the end of the phase:
  • [LETHAL HITS]
  • [SUSTAINED HITS 1]

datasheet.name: Ogryn Combat Stimms
datasheet.description_html: Each time a model in this unit is destroyed by a melee attack, if that model has not fought this phase, roll one D6. On a 4+, do not remove it from play; that destroyed model can fight after the attacking model’s unit has finished making its attacks, and is then removed from play.
